source: Library of Congress, Sanborn Fire Insurance Maps Collection
license: Public domain (no known restrictions; LOC serves these free with no login)
note: LOC search API blocks plain curl/requests via Cloudflare bot challenge. Fetches in this manifest were made through a real browser session (Playwright over CDP on localhost:9222) which passed the challenge; once past it, tile.loc.gov image/derivative URLs work fine with plain curl (verified below).
later_editions_out_of_scope_present_in_s: 1914, 1915, 1917, 1922, 1928, 1929, 1936, 1951, 1952, 1953 volumes also exist for Baltimore Independent Cities under the same bib group (sanborn03573_008 through _055) plus separate items for Baltimore County towns (Towson, Catonsville, Dundalk, Pikesville, Reisterstown, Sparrows Point, etc., earliest Towson 1885) and unrelated Baltimore, Ohio / Baltimore, Michigan sheets that share the search term 'Baltimore' but are a different city.

download_url_pattern.description: Each LOC Sanborn item exposes a 'resources[0].files' array (visible via ?fo=json on the item page) with one entry per sheet. Each sheet entry is a list of derivative files.

derivatives_per_sheet.note: IIIF-served JPEG at fractional scale, e.g. pct:12.5 / pct:25 / pct:50
Full-resolution JPEG2000, typically 8-14 MB per sheet
Full master TIFF, ~130-150 MB per sheet -- do NOT bulk download
Full IIIF Image API 2.x info.json per sheet -- confirms IIIF support

download_url_pattern.sheet_naming: Sheets named e.g. -0000L / -0000R (double-page plates, left/right half), -watr (water supply map), -ind1 (index/key map).

verification_performed.action: curl -I on jp2 URL for sanborn03573_001 sheet 0000L
verification_performed.result: HTTP/2 200, content-length 11880989, server cloudflare, works with plain curl (no auth/challenge on tile.loc.gov)

downloaded_samples.describes: Baltimore, 1890 Sanborn, Vol.1, sheet 0000L (first double-page plate)
Same sheet, IIIF-served JPEG at 50% scale

bulk_download_recipe: For each item ID (e.g. sanborn03573_001), GET https://www.loc.gov/item/<ID>/?fo=json, iterate resources[0]['files'] (one list per sheet), pick the entry with mimetype image/jp2 for full-resolution, and curl its 'url'. The LOC item-page HTML endpoint itself is behind a Cloudflare bot challenge when hit directly with curl/requests -- fetch item JSON through a real browser session (or the loc.gov API with an API key) first, then the returned tile.loc.gov asset URLs download fine with plain curl/wget, no login needed.
